(ix) Bidders shall quote their all-inclusive Prices against each item (i.e., Unit Price, F&I, and applicable GS T) against the Category Bid in the financial portion of the bid on GeM portal. (x) Warranty/Defect Liability Period of Equipments to be procured under subject package shall be in line with Clause GCC 22.1 in SCC enclosed in BuyerATC.
